motivation: The latent gap is not a valid scalar-difficulty signal, but the six completed LUCID cells isolate one repair that is signal-agnostic and mechanically testable: prevent the PI law from lowering difficulty after it has been earned, while preserving the relative return guard as the sole emergency brake. Two of six latent-controller cells anti-gated with zero guard trips and lost terminal frontier exposure. The ratchet is expected to recover fixed-DR-level robustness reliably; it is not expected or preregistered to outperform fixed DR.

selection_disclosure.reason: Seed 8601 is selected after observing that lucid_rg collapsed from lambda=1 to 0.062 there. This is a targeted mechanistic regression test, not a blinded efficacy seed.
selection_disclosure.claim_limit: The seed-8601 result is screening-only. A directional/noninferiority claim requires the frozen three-seed rule below.
selection_disclosure.ledger_correction: The proposed ratchet would change 2/6 historical latent-controller cells, not 0/6: seed-8601 lucid_rg and seed-8600 lucid_s4_rg are the two zero-guard collapse cells.

controller.guard_semantics: A guard trip may lower lambda; a PI-law decrease may not. Each blocked PI decrease is logged as latch_active and counted as ratchet_bind_rows.

design.distribution: one scalar lambda for all 1024 environments; no strata, anchor, yardstick, consolidation, extrapolation, PLR, latch, or residual allocator

baseline.screening: reuse the completed seed-8601 fixed cell and score it afresh with the treatment under the same evaluator seed
baseline.confirmatory: reuse fixed seeds 8600/8601 after exact contract checks and retrain missing fixed seed 8602 from scratch; rerun all fixed seeds only if the contract hashes differ

offline_replay.method: Drop warmup rows from each historical curriculum jsonl; initialize the exact PI controller at lambda=0; feed each logged (gap_quantile, mean_return). Legacy replay reproduces every logged lambda with max absolute error 0. Enable only monotonic=true for the counterfactual replay.
offline_replay.interpretation: The replay validates the mechanical prediction only. After the first blocked decrease, policy and gap trajectories become counterfactual, so capability still requires training and frozen-policy evaluation.

evaluation.matched_seed_rule: treatment and fixed use the identical evaluation seed, panel, preset order, config contract, and evaluator code
secondary: failure-time summaries already present in the frozen receipt

hypotheses.H_R0_manipulation: lambda reaches >=0.95 by iteration 500; no applied non-guard lambda decrease occurs; final-1000 exposure at lambda>=0.95 is >=95%; every guard trip and blocked PI decrease is separately logged. Failure voids capability interpretation and is reported as an implementation/mechanism failure.
hypotheses.H_R1_screening_noninferiority: On seed 8601, ratchet-minus-fixed frontier success AUC and frontier RMS-progress AUC are each >= -0.02, and in-envelope AUCs are each >= -0.01. This is a targeted screen, not a directional claim.
hypotheses.H_R2_three_seed_noninferiority: After confirmatory cells, each frontier co-primary is within 0.02 of fixed in >=2/3 paired training seeds, and each in-envelope co-primary is within 0.01 in >=2/3 paired seeds. Exact seed counts and deltas are reported; no p-value is claimed at n=3.
hypotheses.H_R3_collapse_deletion: No ratchet cell exhibits a non-guard lambda drop >0.30 within any terminal 1000-iteration window while completion is rising. A guard-mediated drop is not an anti-gate and is reported separately.
hypotheses.superiority: Not preregistered. A positive point estimate over fixed is descriptive and cannot turn the Tier-1 signal constraint into a superiority claim.

decision_rule: If H_R0 and H_R1 pass, run seeds 8600/8602 plus the missing fixed-8602 comparator. If H_R0 passes but H_R1 fails, the ratchet deletes controller collapse but does not preserve capability, so stop scalar-gap scheduling. If H_R2 passes, report the ratchet as a stability/noninferiority constraint; capability gains beyond fixed must come from Tier-2 support or Tier-3 optimization. If H_R2 fails, fixed DR remains the baseline and no LUCID performance claim is made.
